title: diff
summary: Return the target ref patch since its merge base with HEAD.
purpose: Return the target ref patch since its merge base with HEAD.

fields.name: target_ref
fields.description: Target ref; option-shaped values and revspecs are forbidden. Omitted: the token group's work base (the project base without a group) start point — origin/<branch> when origin is ahead, else <branch>.

details: Replace {name} in the route with path_parameters.name.
Do not edit the project source on disk directly — every source read and change goes through these tools.
Only merge-base-to-target_ref changes are compared; HEAD-only changes are excluded.
The patch is capped at 1 MiB and truncation is reported.

errors.when: The ref is missing or the merge-base/diff git command failed.
The ref or path has an invalid form.
This token does not have the read scope.
